A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same forward-replay parameter-editing study. The main text, Figures 1-3, Tables 1-7, and scientific appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original knowledge-editing experiments and residual diagnostics, including Llama3 results in Tables 1-5 and GPT-2 XL and GPT-J results in Appendix A.8, Tables 6-7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original editing experiments and diagnostics in Tables 1-7, including the GPT-2 XL and GPT-J appendix results.

M1.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A.3 retain the same FE procedure: optimize the first decisive layer's target, recover subsequent targets through forward propagation, and apply the existing editing updates.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the CounterFact diagnostic experiments and the MCF and ZsRE knowledge-editing benchmarks. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 3, 4, 6, and 7 retain their respective comparator sets. RLEdit remains included for Llama3 and omitted for GPT-2 XL and GPT-J. The newly cited Sun et al. work is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 retains the same three models, 2,000 jointly edited knowledge items per dataset, layer selections, and efficacy, generalization, and specificity metrics. The diagnostic procedures in Appendix A.5 are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The cosine-alignment diagnostic in Table 1, residual and step-size comparisons in Table 2, and FE convergence analysis in Table 5 are retained without additions or revisions.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-7 are unchanged, including the GPT-2 XL and GPT-J appendix results. The reported comparative findings and residual trends are also retained.

T1.justification: The theorems, derivations, and appendix proofs are unchanged. The remark following Theorem 2 replaces > with the positive-definite symbol ≻, aligning its notation with the existing theorem and Equation 11 without changing the mathematical condition.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: analyzing backward spreading and proposing compatible targets through forward replay with essentially unchanged computational cost and improved editing performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of directional distortion, residual convergence, and specificity remain unchanged. Section 7 retains the limitation concerning concentrated editing effort in earlier layers, and Appendix A.8 retains the explanation for omitting RLEdit results.

D1.justification: The implementation explanations in Appendices A.1-A.5, reliance on EasyEdit hyperparameters, and code-access link are unchanged. No technical reproduction instructions or resource-access information are added.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 and the bibliography add Sun et al. (2026), Reverse-engineering model editing on language models. This is a limited citation addition without a substantive revision of the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds funding acknowledgments and Appendix A.9 on author contributions, changes the numbered Impact Statements heading to an unnumbered Impact Statement, and updates an affiliation and correspondence email. The scientific narrative otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 7 moves from vertically centered placement to the top of page 16, above the new author-contributions section. The acknowledgments also reflow the bibliography. Figures, table structures, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves transparency through funding and author-contribution disclosures, adds one related-work citation, and makes the Theorem 2 remark's notation consistent. These are limited improvements in documentation and precision; the scientific methods, evidence, and limitations remain unchanged.
